what_it_does.text: eSuunta Oy is a company registered on 2022-09-03 under the industry code 71121, engineering design and technical consultancy incidental to urban planning.

thesis_fit.text: Industry code 71121 (Engineering design and technical consultancy incidental to urban planning, PRH) is on the thesis list; the memo reads thesis fit as High.

readiness.text: On the radar's rules technology readiness is level 7 and business readiness is level 6, while investment readiness has no level on those rules.

what_the_fund_should_do.text: The memo points to a partner introduction under rule e, but what triggers it is a tender notice from Hämeenlinnan kaupunki, so the fund should first open the notice to see whether it is an award.

whats_missing.text: Gaps on the record: no public evidence for ocean impact; investment readiness is Low on the stored evidence.
